data.description:
Two screens: contract create (pick the template, pick or inline-create the client, fill the declared variables) and contract detail (view the generated contract, print or download it). Built to AS-30's wireframes and states ledgers, consuming the AS-29 tokens (docs/design/tokens/tokens.css).

IMPLEMENTS: docs/engineering/00-d1-v1-milestone-plan.md section 3 rows C-20 (contract create screen) and C-21 (contract detail screen and the v1 delivery artifact); section 4.3 screens 6 and 7 of 7.

DECISION CONTEXT. Merged as one task with a written justification (milestone plan section 8.2): one reviewable claim — "a freelancer can generate a contract and hand it to a client" — at around 450 projected lines. v1's contract DELIVERY IS FREELANCER-MEDIATED: the detail screen must produce a clean printable and downloadable document that the freelancer sends through their own email client, because a client-facing share link (row C-22) and any email sent by us (row C-48) are both out of v1. That is the honest consequence of having no ESP and no sender domain, and it is why this screen's print view is a functional requirement rather than a nicety.

The rendered contract carries the CC BY 4.0 attribution line and the visible placeholder marking produced by the contract-generation task. Do not style either away: the placeholder marking is a legal gate (adapted template text must not reach a real user before the lawyer-agent review clears), not a design blemish.

VERIFICATION: states ledger exercised — empty, variable validation errors, generating, generated, print view; the print stylesheet produces a readable single document; renders at 375px before desktop; tokens only, no magic values.

NOT IN THIS TASK: the template registry or generation logic (the contracts task); any public or client-facing contract route (row C-22, OUT — Rule 1); acceptance capture or e-signature (rows C-23 and C-24, OUT); a contract PDF renderer of our own (row C-25, OUT — the browser's print-to-PDF is v1's answer, and the spike already measured that building one is cheap and still unnecessary).
data.title: D1 v1 UI: contract screens 6-7 (create, detail with print/download)

data.note: screen-rendering task: needs wireframes and states ledgers for screens 6-7

data.body: Carried from the AS-30 cycle-3 review (Priya, P-note): the product's print stylesheet for the contract detail screen must exclude the page heading and the Print/Download actions — the wireframe's print block previews the document region only and does not model that; do not copy its @media print rules as a production stylesheet (wireframe.css header note, corrected in e128b72).

PLAN WRITTEN (cto-owen, tick watcher:79108 loop tick 5, on Opus under the Fable fallback). Plan: .lattice/plans/task_01M1D34P2B9MDD94H9HNYW4ZH5.md. Branch feat/AS-47-contract-screens from master 1a851b5, linked; worktree .worktrees/AS-47.

BASELINE (asc-plan-as47, torn down clean, leak check 0/0): Image asc-plan-as47-test Built — 406 tests / 388 pass / 0 fail / 18 skipped, exit 0 (405 + AS-90's one). Log scratchpad/agent-cto-owen/AS-47/baseline-test.log. Removed my own stale asc-plan-as70-test and asc-plan-as46-test images; left AS-90's asc-inv-as90* alone.

SIX DECISIONS: (1) RAW_OUTPUT_SANCTIONED gets its first entry — the whole line '<%- renderedHtml %>' in views/contract-detail.ejs, count 1 (render.js:29 already commits this task to exactly that); dynamic falsifier = a stored description with markup driven through the real generate, counted in served bytes. (2) Download is a response variant of S7-DEFAULT, not a state, same template: a method=get form with no action and hidden download=1 submits to the page's own URL; route reads req.query.download === '1' as a boolean (value never enters the view model) and answers the same render chrome-free with Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="contract-<row.id>.html" (the row's UUID, never req.params). The file is unstyled by construction (no <style> — P2c; absolute CSS URLs would make a recipient's browser fetch from us) — the pre-wrap loss on multiline is a NAMED limitation with a trigger (AS-49 / AS-90 capture), not a hidden one. (3) No Print control (window.print needs a script); one sentence tells the freelancer to use the browser's Print command; @media print in app.css hides .site-header/.site-nav/.page-title/.doc-actions/.page-meta and targets no contract-doc class (the carried AS-30 comment); screens.test.js's mobile-first case learns a print prelude is a media type, count committed at 1. (4) Screen 6 owns POST /contracts/new and dispatches on intent (generate / new-client / existing-client / add-client) — AS-46 §3.1–3.3's ruling applied unchanged, POST /contracts and POST /clients untouched. (5) One validator: validateFormValue exported from generation.js; the screen marks every failing field in one round trip and generate re-runs the identical function; field copy per field, constant, never from message text. Fields are derived from the declaration (getTemplate(DEFAULT_TEMPLATE_ID).variables where source==='form'), no templateId input exists. (6) S6-ERROR-SYSTEM re-renders in place at 500 (no draft exists, nothing was created, resubmit is the retry — PRG would discard the values); S7-ERROR-NOTFOUND/NOTOWNER byte-identical HTML 404s; S7-ERROR-SYSTEM HTML 500 with a GET retry form. Both system states reached offline by fault injection on the test's own db file via openDatabase (corrupt variables JSON; drop the contracts table).

PARTITIONS: screen 6 = 6 rendered + 1 redirect + 2 path + 1 unrenderable + 1 n/a (S6-GATED-STRIPENOTREADY — no gate, route reads no Connect row) = 11; screen 7 = 3 rendered + 1 rendered-as-NOTFOUND + 1 redirect + 1 unrenderable + 2 n/a = 8.

PREDICTED: +29 cases in NEW test/contract-screens.test.js → 435/417/0/18 against today's master; ≈474/456/0/18 at review after AS-70 (+13) and AS-46 (+26). Every literal a recount at rebase: routes 17→20 (6/14; →25, 6/19 after both lanes), VIEWS 1→3 (→5), source 50→54 (→58), EXPECTED_TEST_FILES 17→18 (→20), RAW_OUTPUT_SANCTIONED 0→1, VIEW_START_TAGS re-measured (+2 for the New-contract anchor this task adds to invoice-form.ejs — AS-46's obligation), APP_CSS_* re-measured, contracts.test.js P8 1→4 (the one API-test edit, stated), expectFiles/P4 6/5 post-AS-70.

SEAMS / MERGE ORDER, binding: AS-70 → AS-46 → AS-47. Three independent reasons: nav links /invoices/new (case 28 red without AS-46); route-surface literals belong in AS-46's test/route-surface.test.js (auth.test.js is 1199 by the ceiling's instrument, AS-70 leaves 1197, this task's +6 does not fit — §3.9 contingency: if AS-46 has not merged, AS-47 does the identical extraction first and says so); screens.test.js is AS-70's file until it merges. The invoice-form.ejs anchor and the mobile-first amendment are the last two edits, on a tip containing both merges.

SPLIT: seam is screen 7 FIRST (closes the /contracts/<id> dangle AS-90's demo walks into; screen 6 first would ship a success path ending on a 404). Trigger: at Unit A (screen 7) green, git diff --stat > 800 changed lines → stop, review Unit A, file AS-47b for screen 6. Projection ≈1,950 total (description's ~450 is ~4× under, as AS-45/46 were). Complexity stays medium.

STAFFING: implement developer-marcus (wrote AS-42's render.js contract and AS-70's row-plus-flag shape; free once AS-70's review passes; Lena is on AS-46's rebase). Review qa-priya (Ruben has AS-70 now and AS-46 next; Priya found P4 and is cold on this code) — Ruben if Priya is busy. 17 recipes in §8 incl. F-raw (3 directions), F-raw-b, F-dl, F-sys, F-print-a/b; reviewer minimum set + 10 M6 probes named.

OPEN (defaults + deadlines, §11): Q1 five wireframe deviations to Jonah (AS-49); Q2 unstyled download (trigger named); Q3 duplicated client-picker logic — third consumer extracts; Q4 S6-ERROR-SYSTEM at 500 (review). Nothing for the board: no spend, no external service, no top-level markdown change.
